hajj.is_on_hajj: activity_pilgrimage + explicitHajj option + destinationb_makka + notreturning home
hajj.shared_travel_events: is_on_a_pilgrimage_trigger includesHajj; direct hajj_journey_events travel pulse is commented out, so do not doublecount that entry
hajj.first_memory_predicate: Preserve original nested NOT block with children has_trait=hajjaj and any_memory(completed_hajj_memory,first_hajj); no independent engine semantics test of malformed/historical state combinations
hajj.first_completion_host: If no hajjaj, addtrait hajjaj; then give_pilgrimage_reward_effect. No pilgrimXPtrack is created by this helper
hajj.repeat_completion_host: If already hajjaj and learning_lifestyle, request major_lifestyle_xp300; else should_get_trait_piety flag for mainpiety additive50; then commonreward
hajj.fulfillment_base_rule: currentRite mandatory ormandatory_hajj doctrine ->10, else5; Hajjoption alone is not thecondition
hajj.fees: Shared activitybody/pomp/distance paths; event choices add independent dynamic costs, so no fixed wholeHajj cost inferred
hajj.ritual_chain_condition: NormalHajj arrival branch; obligatory fidelity withno counter flag takes precedence. Invalidations/eventconditions can intervene; no fixed actual tripduration asserted
